actions.purpose: Explain cited money facts to a person, including what a people-only refund, credit, write-off, or filing decision needs
Hand a money object to another specialist: unaccepted extra work to proposal_contract, payment facts to customer_care_warranty, WCB refreshes and privacy matters to compliance
Protective: record a stop or money exception with its reason code, route, and urgency, and notify the named person
Preserve lien and holdback facts on a job as proposed context for compliance and counsel
Protective: hold a suspicious bill, payment request, or message carrying instructions so no tool acts on it
Protective: freeze payments to a counterparty after any request to change its bank or remittance details
Pause an invoice's reminder schedule for an open dispute, an emergency, or a person taking over
Resume a paused reminder schedule when the fact behind the pause is lifted
Draft a payment_reminder, invoice_cover_note, or payment_receipt from QuickBooks readback facts
Send a billing message only after a person approved that exact draft, in a later run
Draft a bill discrepancy, duplicate, statement, or document question to the vendor contact on file; never about bank details
Send a supplier message only after a person approved that exact draft, in a later run
Commit a deposit, progress, or final invoice intent with its tax once the contract trigger holds
Release holdback a customer or general contractor retained from IronWrap once the release condition is cited
Resolve a payment on an exact match
Three-way match a supplier bill to its PO line and receipt line and record the exception code
Approve a bill with a recorded matched three-way match and a protected, unchanged payee
Draft the list of approved bills due for payment with their timers; a person pays them in the bank
Flag a suspected error, duplicate, short payment, tax difference, statement difference, or margin move with both values
Attribute a bill line's cost before recoverable GST to the job its PO is bound to
Capture a tax document received in the period, such as a subcontractor's T5018 information form, as proposed values
Record the GST snapshot for a closed period from cited tax facts
Draft a GST return or T5018 information return packet for a person to submit
